# Bernstein Injury Law

> > Award-winning Tampa personal injury law firm specializing in car accidents, motorcycle crashes, truck collisions, and rideshare incidents with free consultations and no upfront fees.

Jack G. Bernstein leads a full-service personal injury practice serving Tampa Bay and surrounding Florida communities. The firm handles motor vehicle accidents, wrongful death claims, medical malpractice, and rideshare-related injuries with a focus on maximizing client settlements.
